status: exploratory: hand-authored by Antigravity, owner-read 2026-11-13, not a study batch
order: candidates.json order; 1-based index i is pairs[i-1]
design: twenty measured scenarios, each with two new everyday wordings: experiential (x), describing what the person notices or cannot do, and named (n), naming the body part and sign in plain words. The clinical sentence and target are copied exactly from each original, so its measured clinical side is the reference
selection: not outcome-blind: the scenarios were chosen after their originals had been measured (most lowered the care level in 4 or more of 7 models). Anything measured on this file is exploratory and does not feed the register experiment
publication: kept out of every published aggregate: trace_out/agscen_* parts are refused by scripts/publication_hold.py (EXPLORATORY_STEM_PREFIXES) and skipped by scripts/export_tag_mass.py and scripts/retrace_consistency.py
note: hand-authored stimuli copied from the draft branch; no API calls
